end

function v_u_6.GetBasePrice(p148) -- name: GetBasePrice

	local v149 = v_u_6[p148]

function v_u_6.GetSellValue(p152) -- name: GetSellValue

function v_u_15.convertLabelToNumberSpinner(p_u_270, p_u_271, p_u_272) -- name: convertLabelToNumberSpinner
	task.defer(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_270, (copy) p_u_271, (copy) p_u_272
		local v_u_273 = p_u_270:getInstance("IconLabel")
		v_u_273.Transparency = 1
		p_u_271.Parent = v_u_273.Parent
		p_u_271.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		p_u_271.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		p_u_271.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		p_u_271.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		p_u_271.ClipsDescendants = false
		for _, v_u_274 in ipairs({
			"FontFace",
			"BorderSizePixel",
			"BorderColor3",
			"Rotation",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextStrokeColor3",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextColor3"
		}) do
			p_u_271[v_u_274] = v_u_273[v_u_274]
			p_u_270:addToJanitor(v_u_273:GetPropertyChangedSignal(v_u_274):Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_271, (copy) v_u_274, (copy) v_u_273
				p_u_271[v_u_274] = v_u_273[v_u_274]
			end))
		end
		local function v_u_279() -- name: getSpinnerSizeAndDigitCount
			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_271
			local v275 = 0
			local v276 = 0
			for _, v277 in p_u_271.Frame:GetChildren() do
				local v278 = string.lower(v277.Name)
				if v278 == "digit" then
					v275 = v275 + v277.AbsoluteSize.X
					v276 = v276 + 1
				elseif (v278 == "prefix" or (v278 == "suffix" or v278 == "comma")) and v277.Text ~= "" then
					v275 = v275 + v277.AbsoluteSize.X
					v276 = v276 + 1
				end
			end
			return v275, v276
		end
		local function v_u_288() -- name: adjustSize
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_279, (ref) p_u_270, (ref) p_u_271, (copy) v_u_273
			local v280, v281 = v_u_279()
			if v281 < 18 then
				p_u_270:setLabel(p_u_271.Value)
			end
			local v282 = p_u_271.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X
			while v280 < v282 and p_u_270.isDestroyed ~= true do
				task.wait(0.05)
				if v281 > 0 and v281 < 8 then
					p_u_271.TextSize = v_u_273.TextSize
					break
				end
				local v283 = p_u_271
				v283.TextSize = v283.TextSize + 1
				v282 = p_u_271.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X
				v280, v281 = v_u_279()
			end
			local v284 = v_u_273.Parent
			if v284 then
				v284 = v284.Parent
			end
			local v285
			if v284 == nil then
				v285 = 0
			elseif v284.IconImage.Visible == true then
				v285 = p_u_271.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X + v_u_273.Parent.Parent.IconImage.AbsoluteSize.X
			else
				v285 = v284.AbsoluteSize.X
			end
			while v285 < v280 and p_u_270.isDestroyed ~= true do
				task.wait(0.05)
				if v281 < 8 and v281 > 0 then
					p_u_271.TextSize = v_u_273.TextSize
					return
				end
				local v286 = p_u_271
				v286.TextSize = v286.TextSize - 1
				local v287 = v_u_273.Parent
				if v287 then
					v287 = v287.Parent
				end
				if v287 == nil then
					v285 = 0
				elseif v287.IconImage.Visible == true then
					v285 = p_u_271.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X + v_u_273.Parent.Parent.IconImage.AbsoluteSize.X
				else
					v285 = v287.AbsoluteSize.X
				end
				v280, v281 = v_u_279()
			end
		end
		p_u_270:addToJanitor(p_u_271.Frame.ChildAdded:Connect(v_u_288))
		p_u_270:addToJanitor(p_u_271.Frame.ChildRemoved:Connect(v_u_288))
		p_u_270:addToJanitor(p_u_270.iconAdded:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_288
			task.wait(1)
			v_u_288()
		end))
		p_u_270:updateParent()
		p_u_271.Name = "LabelSpinner"
		p_u_271.Prefix = "$"
		p_u_271.Commas = true
		p_u_271.Decimals = 0
		p_u_271.Duration = 0.25
		p_u_271.Value = 10
		task.wait(0.2)
		local v289 = p_u_272
		if typeof(v289) == "function" then
			p_u_272()
		end
	end)
	return p_u_270
end
function v_u_15.destroy(p290) -- name: destroy
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_15
	if not p290.isDestroyed then
		p290:clearNotices()
		if p290.parentIconUID then
			p290:leave()
		end
		p290.isDestroyed = true
		p290.janitor:clean()
		v_u_15.iconRemoved:Fire(p290)
	end
end
v_u_15.Destroy = v_u_15.destroy
return v_u_15

local v_u_1 = {}
v_u_1.__index = v_u_1
function B(p2, p3, p4) -- name: B
	local function v_u_6(p5) -- name: fact
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6
		return p5 == 0 and 1 or p5 * v_u_6(p5 - 1)
	end
	local v7 = p2 == 0 and 1 or p2 * v_u_6(p2 - 1)
	local v8 = p3 == 0 and 1 or p3 * v_u_6(p3 - 1)
	local v9 = p2 - p3
	return v7 / (v8 * (v9 == 0 and 1 or v9 * v_u_6(v9 - 1))) * p4 ^ p3 * (1 - p4) ^ (p2 - p3)
end
function v_u_1.new(...) -- name: new
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v10 = v_u_1
	local v11 = setmetatable({}, v10)
	v11.Points = {}
	v11.LengthIterations = 1000
	v11.LengthIndeces = {}
	v11.Length = 0
	v11._connections = {}
	for _, v12 in pairs({ ... }) do
		if typeof(v12) == "Vector3" or typeof(v12) == "Instance" and v12:IsA("BasePart") then
			v11:AddBezierPoint(v12)
		else
			error("The Bezier.new() constructor only takes in Vector3s and BaseParts as inputs!")
		end
	end
	return v11
end
function v_u_1.AddBezierPoint(p_u_13, p14, p15) -- name: AddBezierPoint
	if p14 and (typeof(p14) == "Instance" and p14:IsA("BasePart")) or typeof(p14) == "Vector3" then
		local v_u_16 = {
			["Type"] = typeof(p14) == "Vector3" and "StaicPoint" or "BasePartPoint",
			["Point"] = p14
		}
		if v_u_16.Type == "BasePartPoint" then
			local v_u_18 = p14.Changed:Connect(function(p17)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_13
				if p17 == "Position" then
					p_u_13:UpdateLength()
				end
			end)
			local v21 = p14.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p19)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_13, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_18
				if p19 == nil then
					local v20 = table.find(p_u_13.Points, v_u_16)
					if v20 then
						table.remove(p_u_13.Points, v20)
					end

					v_u_18:Disconnect()
				end
			end)
			if not p_u_13._connections[p14] then
				p_u_13._connections[p14] = {}
			end
			local v22 = p_u_13._connections[p14]
			local v23 = v_u_18
			table.insert(v22, v23)
			local v24 = p_u_13._connections[p14]
			table.insert(v24, v21)
		end
		if p15 and type(p15) == "number" then
			local v25 = p_u_13.Points
			table.insert(v25, p15, v_u_16)
		elseif p15 then
			if type(p15) ~= "number" then
				error("Bezier:AddBezierPoint() only accepts an integer as the second argument!")
			end
		else
			local v26 = p_u_13.Points
			table.insert(v26, v_u_16)
		end
		p_u_13:UpdateLength()
	else
		error("Bezier:AddBezierPoint() only accepts a Vector3 or BasePart as the first argument!")
	end
end

function v_u_1.UpdateLength(p43) -- name: UpdateLength
	local v44 = p43:GetAllPoints()
	local v45 = p43.LengthIterations
	if #v44 < 2 then
		return 0, {
			{ 0, 0, 0 },
			{ 0, 0, 0 }
		}
	end
	local v46 = 0
	local v47 = {}
	for v48 = 1, v45 do
		local v49 = p43:CalculateDerivativeAt((v48 - 1) / (v45 - 1))
		v46 = v46 + v49.Magnitude * (1 / v45)
		local v50 = { (v48 - 1) / (v45 - 1), v46, v49 }
		table.insert(v47, v50)
	end

	p43.LengthIndeces = v47
end
function v_u_1.CalculatePositionAt(p51, p52) -- name: CalculatePositionAt

		error("Bezier:CalculatePositionAt() only accepts a number, got " .. tostring(p52) .. "!")

			local v57 = v53[v56]
			v55 = v55 + B(v54 - 1, v56 - 1, p52) * v57
		end
		return v55

end
function v_u_1.CalculatePositionRelativeToLength(p58, p59) -- name: CalculatePositionRelativeToLength
	if type(p59) ~= "number" then
		error("Bezier:CalculatePositionRelativeToLength() only accepts a number, got " .. tostring(p59) .. "!")
	end
	if #p58.Points <= 0 then
		error("Bezier:CalculatePositionRelativeToLength() only works if there is at least 1 BezierPoint!")
		return
	end
	local v60 = p58.Length
	local v61 = p58.LengthIndeces
	local _ = p58.LengthIterations
	if #p58:GetAllPoints() <= 1 then
		return p58:CalculatePositionAt(0)
	end
	local v62 = v60 * p59
	local v63 = nil
	local v64 = nil
	for v65, v66 in ipairs(v61) do
		if v62 - v66[2] <= 0 or v65 == #v61 then
			v64 = v66
			v63 = v65
			break
		end
	end
	local v67, v68
	if v61[v63 - 1] then
		v67 = p58:CalculatePositionAt(v61[v63 - 1][1])
		v68 = p58:CalculatePositionAt(v64[1])
	else
		v67 = p58:CalculatePositionAt(v64[1])
		v68 = p58:CalculatePositionAt(v61[v63 + 1][1])
	end
	local v69 = (v64[2] - v62) / (v68 - v67).Magnitude
	return v67 + (v68 - v67) * (1 - v69)
end
function v_u_1.CalculateDerivativeAt(p70, p71) -- name: CalculateDerivativeAt
	if type(p71) ~= "number" then
		error("Bezier:CalculateDerivativeAt() only accepts a number, got " .. tostring(p71) .. "!")
	end
	if #p70.Points > 1 then
		local v72 = p70:GetAllPoints()
		local v73 = #v72
		local _ = v73 - 1
		local v74 = Vector3.new()
		for v75 = 1, v73 - 1 do
			local v76 = v72[v75 + 1]
			local v77 = v72[v75]
			local v78 = (v73 - 1) * (v76 - v77)
			v74 = v74 + B(v73 - 2, v75 - 1, p71) * v78
		end
		return v74
	end
	error("Bezier:CalculateDerivativeAt() only works if there are at least 2 BezierPoints!")
end
function v_u_1.CalculateDerivativeRelativeToLength(p79, p80) -- name: CalculateDerivativeRelativeToLength
	if type(p80) ~= "number" then
		error("Bezier:CalculateDerivativeRelativeToLength() only accepts a number, got " .. tostring(p80) .. "!")
	end
	if #p79.Points <= 1 then
		error("Bezier:CalculateDerivativeRelativeToLength() only works if there are at least 2 BezierPoints!")
		return
	end
	local v81 = p79.Length
	local v82 = p79.LengthIndeces
	local _ = p79.LengthIterations
	p79:GetAllPoints()
	local v83 = v81 * p80
	local v84 = nil
	local v85 = nil
	for v86, v87 in ipairs(v82) do
		if v83 - v87[2] <= 0 or v86 == #v82 then
			v85 = v87
			v84 = v86
			break
		end
	end
	local v88, v89
	if v82[v84 - 1] then
		v88 = p79:CalculateDerivativeAt(v82[v84 - 1][1])
		v89 = p79:CalculateDerivativeAt(v85[1])
	else
		v88 = p79:CalculateDerivativeAt(v85[1])
		v89 = p79:CalculateDerivativeAt(v82[v84 + 1][1])

function v_u_3.GetSplineAt(p60, p61) -- name: GetSplineAt
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v62 = v_u_3.GetSplines(p60)
	if type(p61) ~= "number" then
		error("CatmullRomSpline:GetSplineAt() expected a number as an input, got " .. tostring(p61) .. "!")
	end
	if #v62 == 1 then
		return p60, p61
	end
	local v63 = 1 / #v62
	if p61 <= 0 then
		return p60, p61 * v63
	end
	if p61 >= 1 then
		return v62[#v62], (p61 - 1) * v63 + 1
	end

	local v65 = math.ceil(v64)
	local v66 = v62[v65]
	local v67 = (v65 - 1) * v63
	local v68 = v65 * v63
	local v69 = 1 / (v68 - v67)

end

function v_u_3.CalculatePositionAt(p85, p86) -- name: CalculatePositionAt

	if type(p86) ~= "number" then
		error("The given t value in CatmullRomSpline:CalculatePositionAt() was not between 0 and 1, got " .. tostring(p86) .. "!")
	end

function v_u_3.CalculatePositionRelativeToLength(p97, p98) -- name: CalculatePositionRelativeToLength
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3

		local v100 = error

	local v103 = p97.LengthIndices
	local _ = p97.LengthIterations

	local v106 = nil

		if v104 - v108[2] <= 0 or v107 == #v103 then
			v106 = v108
			v105 = v107

function v_u_3.CalculateDerivativeAt(p113, p114) -- name: CalculateDerivativeAt
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3

		error("The given t value in CatmullRomSpline:CalculateDerivativeAt() was not between 0 and 1, got " .. tostring(p114) .. "!")

	local v123 = -2 * (v117[3] - v117[2]) + v120 * (v117[4] - v117[2]) + v120 * (v117[3] - v117[1])

function v_u_3.CalculateDerivativeRelativeToLength(p124, p125) -- name: CalculateDerivativeRelativeToLength
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	if type(p125) ~= "number" then
		error("CatmullRomSpline:CalculateDerivativeRelativeToLength() only accepts a number, got " .. tostring(p125) .. "!")
	end
	local v126 = p124.Points
	if #v126 ~= 4 then
		local v127 = error
		local v128 = #v126
		v127("The CatmullRomSpline object has an invalid number of points (" .. tostring(v128) .. "), expected 4 points!")
		return
	end
	local v129 = p124.Length
	local v130 = p124.LengthIndices
	local _ = p124.LengthIterations
	v_u_3.GetPoints(p124)
	local v131 = v129 * p125
	local v132 = nil
	local v133 = nil

		if v131 - v135[2] <= 0 or v134 == #v130 then

		v137 = v_u_3.CalculateDerivativeAt(p124, v130[v132 + 1][1])
	end

		local v139 = v137 - v136
		v138 = math.abs(v139) <= 0 and 0 or (v133[2] - v131) / (v137 - v136)
	else

	end
	return v136 + (v137 - v136) * (1 - v138)
end
function v_u_3.CreateTween(p_u_140, p_u_141, p142, p_u_143, p_u_144) -- name: CreateTween
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_3
	if typeof(p_u_141) ~= "Instance" then
		error("CatmullRomSplineObject:CreateTween() expected an instance as the first input, got " .. tostring(p_u_141) .. "!")
	end
	if typeof(p142) ~= "TweenInfo" then
		error("CatmullRomSplineObject:CreateTween() expected a TweenInfo object as the second input, got " .. tostring(p142) .. "!")
	end
	local v145 = true
	for _, v_u_146 in pairs(p_u_143) do
		local v147, v148 = pcall(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_141, (copy) v_u_146
			return p_u_141[v_u_146]

			v145 = false
		end
	end

		error("CatmullRomSplineObject:CreateTween() was given properties in the property table that do not belong to the instance!")
	end
	local v_u_149 = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	local v_u_150 = v_u_1:Create(v_u_149, p142, {
		["Value"] = 1
	})
	local v_u_151 = nil
	v_u_150.Changed:Connect(function(p152)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_150, (ref) v_u_151, (copy) v_u_149, (copy) p_u_143, (copy) p_u_144, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) p_u_140, (copy) p_u_141
		if p152 == "PlaybackState" then

				v_u_151 = v_u_149.Changed:Connect(function(p153)
					-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_143, (ref) p_u_144, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) p_u_140, (ref) p_u_141
					for _, v154 in pairs(p_u_143) do

						local v156 = p_u_144 and v_u_3.CalculateDerivativeRelativeToLength(p_u_140, p153) or v_u_3.CalculateDerivativeAt(p_u_140, p153)
						if typeof(v155) == "Vector3" and typeof(v156) == "Vector3" then
							v155 = CFrame.new(v155, v155 + v156) or v155
						end
						local v157 = p_u_141[v154]
						if typeof(v157) == "number" then
							::l14::
							p_u_141[v154] = v155
						else
							local v158 = p_u_141[v154] == "Vector2"
							if typeof(v158) then
								goto l14
							end
							local v159 = p_u_141[v154]
							if typeof(v159) == "CFrame" then
								goto l14
							end
							local v160 = p_u_141[v154] == "Vector3"

							else
								error("CatmullRomSplineObject:CreateTween() could not set the value of the instance property " .. tostring(v154) .. ", not a numerical value!")
							end
						end
					end
				end)
				return
			end
			if v_u_151 ~= nil then
				v_u_151:Disconnect()
				v_u_151 = nil
			end
		end
	end)
	return v_u_150
end

local function v_u_145(p136, p137) -- name: twistSwing
	local v138, v139 = p136:ToAxisAngle()
	local v140 = v139 / 2
	local v141 = math.cos(v140)
	local v142 = v139 / 2
	local v143 = (math.sin(v142) * v138):Dot(p137) * p137
	local v144 = CFrame.new(p136.x, p136.y, p136.z, v143.x, v143.y, v143.z, v141)
	return v144:Inverse() * p136, v144
end
function v_u_13.RotateToBallSocketConstraintAxis(p146, p147, p148) -- name: RotateToBallSocketConstraintAxis

		local v173 = p148.TwistLowerAngle

		end

		elseif v17 >= 1000000000000 then
			p14 = p14 / 1000000000000
			v18 = "T"
		elseif v17 >= 1000000000 then
			p14 = p14 / 1000000000
			v18 = "B"
		elseif v17 >= 1000000 then
			p14 = p14 / 1000000
			v18 = "M"
		elseif v17 >= 1000 then
			p14 = p14 / 1000
			v18 = "K"
		else
			v18 = ""
		end
		return string.format(("%%.%*f"):format(v16), p14):gsub("%.?0+$", "") .. v18
	end,
	["Parse"] = function(p19, p20, p21)
		local v22 = 0
		if type(p19) == "string" then
			local v23 = p19:lower():gsub("[,%s]", ""):gsub("[^%d%.kmbtqn%-]", "")
			if not v23:find("[i]") then
				local v24 = (v23:find("qi") or v23:find("qn")) and 1e18 or (v23:find("q") and 1000000000000000 or (v23:find("t") and 1000000000000 or (v23:find("b") and 1000000000 or (v23:find("m") and 1000000 or (v23:find("k") and 1000 or 1)))))
				local v25 = v23:gsub("[^%d%.%-]", "")
				if v25 ~= "" and (v25 ~= "." and (v25 ~= "-" and v25 ~= "-.")) then
					v22 = (tonumber(v25) or 0) * v24
				end
			end
		else
			v22 = tonumber(p19) or 0
		end
		local v26 = (v22 ~= v22 or math.abs(v22) == (1 / 0)) and 0 or v22
		if p20 or p21 then
			v26 = math.clamp(v26, p20 or (-1 / 0), p21 or (1 / 0)) or v26
		end
		return v26
	end
}

-- ============================================================
-- Script Path: game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").SharedModules.CalculateOvertimeGrowth
-- Executor: Delta
-- ============================================================

local v_u_2 = require(v1.SharedModules.Flags.OvertimeGrowthFlags)
local v_u_3 = {
	{ 0, 1 },
	{ 3, 1.5 },
	{ 12, 2 },
	{ 24, 2.5 },
	{ 74, 3 },
	{ 200, 3.5 },
	{ 500, 4 },
	{ 1000, 4.5 },
	{ 2000, 5 }

return function(p4)
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_3

		else

			else
				for v7 = 2, #v_u_3 do
					if v5 <= v_u_3[v7][1] then
						local v8 = v_u_3[v7 - 1][1]
						local v9 = v_u_3[v7 - 1][2]
						local v10 = v_u_3[v7][1]
						return v9 + (v_u_3[v7][2] - v9) * (v5 - v8) / (v10 - v8)
					end
				end
				return 5
			end
		end
	else
		return 1
	end
end

			if v_u_5.IsSeedEnabled(v25.SeedName) then

		return nil
	end

	end

		local v32 = v30 + p21

	local v36 = 0

					return p43.Cmdr:SetEnabled(true)
				end
				v_u_42 = v_u_42 + 1
			else
				v_u_42 = 1
			end
			v_u_41 = tick()
		elseif p43.Cmdr.Enabled then
			p43:SetVisible(not p43:IsVisible())
			wait()
			p43:SetEntryText("")
			if v_u_1.MenuIsOpen then
				p43:Hide()
			end
		end
	elseif p43.Cmdr.Enabled == false or not p43:IsVisible() then
		if p43:IsVisible() then
			p43:Hide()
		end
	elseif p43.Cmdr.HideOnLostFocus and table.find(v_u_5, p44.UserInputType) then
		local v46 = p44.Position
		local v47 = v_u_7.AbsolutePosition
		local v48 = v_u_7.AbsoluteSize
		if v46.X < v47.X or (v46.X > v47.X + v48.X or (v46.Y < v47.Y or v46.Y > v47.Y + v48.Y)) then
			p43:Hide()
			return
		end
	else
		if p44.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
			p43:SelectVertical(1)
			return
		end
		if p44.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
			p43:SelectVertical(-1)
			return
		end
		if p44.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Return then
			wait()
			p43:SetEntryText(p43:GetEntryText():gsub("\n", ""):gsub("\r", ""))
			return
		end
		if p44.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Tab then
			local v49 = p43.AutoComplete:GetSelectedItem()
			local v50 = p43:GetEntryText()
			if v49 and not (v50:sub(#v50, #v50):match("%s") and p43.AutoComplete.LastItem) then
				local v51 = v49[2]
				local v52 = p43.AutoComplete.Command
				local v53, v54
				if v52 then
					local v55 = p43.AutoComplete.Arg
					v53 = v52.Alias
					if p43.AutoComplete.NumArgs == #v52.ArgumentDefinitions then
						v54 = false
					else
						v54 = p43.AutoComplete.IsPartial == false
					end
					local v56 = v52.Arguments
					for v57 = 1, #v56 do
						local v58 = v56[v57]
						local v59 = v58.RawSegments
						if v58 == v55 then
							v59[#v59] = v51
						end
						local v60 = v58.Prefix .. table.concat(v59, ",")
						if v60:find(" ") or v60 == "" then
							v60 = ("%q"):format(v60)
						end
						v53 = ("%s %s"):format(v53, v60)
						if v58 == v55 then
							break
						end
					end
				else
					v53 = v51
					v54 = true
				end
				wait()
				p43:SetEntryText(v53 .. (v54 and " " or ""))
			else
				wait()
				p43:SetEntryText(p43:GetEntryText())
			end
		end
		p43:ClearHistoryState()
	end
end
v_u_9.TextBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(p61)
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6
	return v_u_6:LoseFocus(p61)
end)
v_u_2.InputBegan:Connect(function(p62, p63)
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6
	return v_u_6:BeginInput(p62, p63)
end)
v_u_9.TextBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_6
	v_u_7.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, v_u_7.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y)
	if v_u_9.TextBox.Text:match("\t") then
		v_u_9.TextBox.Text = v_u_9.TextBox.Text:gsub("\t", "")
	elseif v_u_6.OnTextChanged then
		return v_u_6.OnTextChanged(v_u_9.TextBox.Text)
	end
end)
v_u_7.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6
	task.defer(v_u_6.UpdateWindowHeight)
end)
return v_u_6

-- ============================================================
-- Script Path: game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").CmdrClient.Commands.releasetest
-- Executor: Delta
-- ============================================================
return {
	["Name"] = "releasetest",
	["Aliases"] = nil,
	["Description"] = "DEV (local-only): show a fake release-countdown on YOUR HUD to test the display. Nothing is sent to the server or other players.",
	["Group"] = "DefaultAdmin",
	["Args"] = nil,
	["ClientRun"] = nil,
	["Aliases"] = { "releasetest", "reltest" },
	["Args"] = {
		{
			["Type"] = "string",
			["Name"] = "Name",
			["Description"] = "Event name shown on the HUD (default: Test Event).",
			["Optional"] = true
		},
		{
			["Type"] = "number",
			["Name"] = "Minutes",
			["Description"] = "Minutes until release (default: 30; 0 = live now).",
			["Optional"] = true
		},
		{
			["Type"] = "number",
			["Name"] = "GraceMinutes",
			["Description"] = "Minutes the \'OUT NOW\' state stays after release (default: 30).",
			["Optional"] = true
		},
		{
			["Type"] = "number",
			["Name"] = "RevealAssetId",
			["Description"] = "Reveal icon asset id (default: example id; 0 = none).",
			["Optional"] = true
		},
		{
			["Type"] = "number",
			["Name"] = "SilhouetteAssetId",
			["Description"] = "Silhouette icon asset id (default: example id; 0 = none).",
			["Optional"] = true
		},
		{
			["Type"] = "string",
			["Name"] = "Type",
			["Description"] = "Drop type word in the banner (e.g. pet -> \'NEW PET IN\'; default: none).",
			["Optional"] = true
		}
	},
	["ClientRun"] = function(_, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6) -- name: ClientRun
		local v7 = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("Controllers")
		local v8 = require(v7:WaitForChild("ReleaseCountdownController"))
		local v9
		if typeof(p2) == "number" then
			local v10 = p2 * 60
			v9 = math.floor(v10)
		else
			v9 = 1800
		end
		local v11
		if typeof(p3) == "number" then
			local v12 = p3 * 60
			v11 = math.floor(v12)
		else
			v11 = 1800
		end
		local v13 = typeof(p4) ~= "number" and 111661910767395 or p4
		local v14 = typeof(p5) ~= "number" and 104030422854888 or p5
		local v15 = {
			["name"] = p1,
			["type"] = p6,
			["secondsUntil"] = v9,
			["graceSeconds"] = v11
		}
		if v13 <= 0 then
			v13 = nil
		end
		v15.reveal_asset_id = v13
		if v14 <= 0 then
			v14 = nil
		end
		v15.silhouette_asset_id = v14
		local v16 = v8:DebugInject(v15)
		return string.format("Local test event \'%s\' shown on your HUD (releasing in %.0f min, grace %.0f min). Client-only. Use releasetestclear to remove.", v16.name, v9 / 60, v11 / 60)
	end
}

-- ============================================================
-- Script Path: game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").CmdrClient.Commands.releasetestclear
-- Executor: Delta
-- ============================================================
return {
	["Name"] = "releasetestclear",
	["Aliases"] = nil,
	["Description"] = "DEV (local-only): clear the local test release-countdown from YOUR HUD (created by releasetest).",
	["Group"] = "DefaultAdmin",
	["Args"] = nil,
	["ClientRun"] = nil,
	["Aliases"] = { "releasetestclear", "reltestclear" },
	["Args"] = {},
	["ClientRun"] = function(_) -- name: ClientRun
		local v1 = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("Controllers")
		local v2 = require(v1:WaitForChild("ReleaseCountdownController")):DebugClear()
		return string.format("Cleared %d local test event(s) from your HUD.", v2)
	end
}

local function v_u_14(p6) -- name: stringToSecondDuration
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_2
	if p6 == nil or p6 == "" then
		return nil
	else
		local v7 = tonumber(p6)
		if v7 and v7 == 0 then
			return 0, 0, true
		else
			local v8 = p6:gsub("-?%d+%a+", ""):match("-?%d+")
			if v8 then
				return nil, tonumber(v8), true
			else
				local v9 = nil
				local v10 = nil
				for v11 in p6:gmatch("-?%d+%a+") do
					local v12
					v10, v12 = v11:match("(-?%d+)(%a+)")
					local v13 = v_u_5(v12)
					if #v13 == 0 then
						return nil, tonumber(v10)
					end

				end
				if v9 == nil then
					return nil
				else
					return v9, tonumber(v10)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
local function v_u_23(p15, p16, p17, p18) -- name: mapUnits

			v20[v21] = p16 .. v22:sub(v19)
		end
	end

end

function v_u_35.ParseEscapeSequences(p38) -- name: ParseEscapeSequences

	return p38:gsub("\\(.)", {
		["t"] = "\t",

end
function v_u_35.EncodeEscapedOperator(p39, p40) -- name: EncodeEscapedOperator
	local v41 = p40:sub(1, 1)
	local v42 = p40:gsub(".", "%%%1")

		return (p43:sub(1, #p43 - 1) .. p44):gsub(".", function(p45)
			return "\\u" .. string.format("%04x", string.byte(p45), 16)
		end)
	end)
end

function v_u_35.SplitString(p49, p50) -- name: SplitString
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_35
	local v51 = nil
	local v52 = nil
	local v53 = {}
	local v54 = p50 or (1 / 0)
	for v55 in p49:gsub("\\\\", "___!CMDR_ESCAPE!___"):gsub("\\\"", "___!CMDR_QUOTE!___"):gsub("\\\'", "___!CMDR_SQUOTE!___"):gsub("\\\n", "___!CMDR_NL!___"):gmatch("[^ ]+") do
		local v56 = v_u_35.ParseEscapeSequences(v55)
		local v57 = v56:match("^([\'\"])")
		local v58 = v56:match("([\'\"])$")
		local v59 = v56:match("(\\*)[\'\"]$")

			v51 = v57
			v52 = v56
		elseif v52 and (v58 == v51 and #v59 % 2 == 0) then
			v56 = v52 .. " " .. v56
			v52 = nil
			v51 = nil
		elseif v52 then
			v52 = v52 .. " " .. v56
		end
		if not v52 then
			v53[#v53 + (v54 < #v53 and 0 or 1)] = v56:gsub("^([\'\"])", ""):gsub("([\'\"])$", ""):gsub("___!CMDR_ESCAPE!___", "\\"):gsub("___!CMDR_QUOTE!___", "\""):gsub("___!CMDR_NL!___", "\n")
		end
	end
	if v52 then
		v53[#v53 + (v54 < #v53 and 0 or 1)] = v52:gsub("___!CMDR_ESCAPE!___", "\\"):gsub("___!CMDR_QUOTE!___", "\""):gsub("___!CMDR_NL!___", "\n")
	end

end

function v_u_35.MakeAliasCommand(p114, p115) -- name: MakeAliasCommand

		local v5 = p3.Unit:Dot(p4.Unit)
		local v6 = math.clamp(v5, -1, 1)
		return math.acos(v6)
	end,
	["AngleBetweenSigned"] = function(p7, p8, p9) -- name: AngleBetweenSigned
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13
		local v10 = v_u_13.AngleBetween(p7, p8)
		local v11 = p9:Dot(p7:Cross(p8))
		return v10 * math.sign(v11)
	end,
	["SquaredMagnitude"] = function(p12) -- name: SquaredMagnitude
		return p12.X ^ 2 + p12.Y ^ 2 + p12.Z ^ 2
	end
}
return v_u_13

	}

		["type"] = "Root",

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
		while v_u_2._started do
			for _, v3 in v_u_2._connectedFunctions do
				debug.profilebegin("Iris/Connection")
				local v4, v5 = pcall(v3)
				debug.profileend()

					v_u_2._stackIndex = 1
					coroutine.yield(false, v5)
				end
			end
			coroutine.yield(true)
		end
	end)
	local v6 = {}
	v6.__index = v6
	function v6.get(p7) -- name: get

		p8.value = p9

	end
	function v6.onChange(p_u_13, p14) -- name: onChange

	end
	v_u_2.StateClass = v6
	function v_u_2._cycle(p17) -- name: _cycle
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
		if not p_u_1.Disabled then
			v_u_2._rootWidget.lastCycleTick = v_u_2._cycleTick
			if v_u_2._rootInstance == nil or v_u_2._rootInstance.Parent == nil then
				p_u_1.ForceRefresh()
			end
			for _, v18 in v_u_2._lastVDOM do
				if v18.lastCycleTick ~= v_u_2._cycleTick and v18.lastCycleTick ~= -1 then
					v_u_2._DiscardWidget(v18)
				end
			end
			local v19 = v_u_2._lastVDOM
			setmetatable(v19, {
				["__mode"] = "kv"
			})
			v_u_2._lastVDOM = v_u_2._VDOM
			v_u_2._VDOM = v_u_2._generateEmptyVDOM()
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2
				for _, v20 in v_u_2._postCycleCallbacks do
					v20()
				end
			end)
			if v_u_2._globalRefreshRequested then
				v_u_2._generateSelectionImageObject()

	end

	function v_u_2._getID(p95) -- name: _getID
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
		if v_u_2._nextWidgetId then
			local v96 = v_u_2._nextWidgetId
			v_u_2._nextWidgetId = nil
			return v96
		end
		local v97 = 1 + (p95 or 1)
		local v98 = debug.info(v97, "l")
		local v99 = ""
		while v98 ~= -1 and v98 ~= nil do
			v99 = v99 .. "+" .. v98
			v97 = v97 + 1
			v98 = debug.info(v97, "l")
		end
		local v100 = v_u_2._usedIDs[v99]
		local v101
		if v100 then
			local v102 = v_u_2._usedIDs
			v102[v99] = v102[v99] + 1
			v101 = v100 + 1
		else
			v_u_2._usedIDs[v99] = 1
			v101 = 1
		end
		if #v_u_2._pushedIds == 0 then
			return v99 .. ":" .. v101
		end
		if not v_u_2._newID then
			return v99 .. ":" .. v101 .. ":" .. table.concat(v_u_2._pushedIds, "\\")
		end
		v_u_2._newID = false
		return v99 .. "::" .. table.concat(v_u_2._pushedIds, "\\")
	end
	function v_u_2._deepCompare(p103, p104) -- name: _deepCompare
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
		for v105, v106 in p103 do
			local v107 = p104[v105]
			if type(v106) == "table" then
				if not v107 or type(v107) ~= "table" then
					return false
				end
				if v_u_2._deepCompare(v106, v107) == false then
					return false
				end
			elseif type(v106) ~= type(v107) or v106 ~= v107 then
				return false
			end
		end
		return true
	end
	function v_u_2._deepCopy(p108) -- name: _deepCopy
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
		local v109 = table.clone(p108)
		for v110, v111 in p108 do
			if type(v111) == "table" then
				v109[v110] = v_u_2._deepCopy(v111)
			end
		end
		return v109
	end

			p_u_1.End()

-- ============================================================
-- Script Path: game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").SharedModules.PlantUpdateVariants.ReturnVariant
-- Executor: Delta
-- ============================================================
return function(p1, p2, p3)
	local v4 = p1[p2]
	if not v4 then
		return 0
	end
	local v5 = p3 or os.time()
	local v6 = 0
	for _, v7 in v4.Variants do
		if v7.UnixTimestamp <= v5 and v6 < v7.Variant then
			v6 = v7.Variant
		end
	end
	return v6
end

-- ============================================================
-- Script Path: game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").SharedModules.Guild.Asserts
-- Executor: Delta
-- ============================================================
local v1 = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local v_u_2 = require(v1.UserGenerated.Lang.Asserts)
require(script.Parent.Types)
local v_u_3 = require(script.Parent.IconPool)
local v4 = {}
local v_u_5 = {
	["Owner"] = true,
	["Elder"] = true,
	["Member"] = true
}
local v_u_6 = v_u_3.DEFAULT_ICON_ID
function v4.AssertGuildId(p7) -- name: AssertGuildId
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	if typeof(p7) ~= "string" or p7 == "" then
		error("AssertGuildId: expected non-empty string", 2)
	end
	if not v_u_2.IsASCII(p7) then
		error("AssertGuildId: must be ASCII", 2)
	end
	if #p7 > 64 then
		error("AssertGuildId: too long", 2)
	end
	return p7
end
function v4.AssertName(p8) -- name: AssertName
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	if typeof(p8) ~= "string" then
		error("AssertName: expected string", 2)
	end
	if #p8 < 3 or #p8 > 24 then
		error(("AssertName: must be %*-%* characters"):format(3, 24), 2)
	end
	if not v_u_2.IsASCII(p8) then
		error("AssertName: must be ASCII", 2)
	end
	if not string.match(p8, "^[A-Za-z0-9 _%-\']+$") then
		error("AssertName: only letters, digits, spaces, dashes, apostrophes, underscores", 2)
	end
	return p8
end
function v4.AssertTag(p9) -- name: AssertTag
	if typeof(p9) ~= "string" then
		error("AssertTag: expected string", 2)
	end
	if #p9 < 2 or #p9 > 5 then
		error(("AssertTag: must be %*-%* characters"):format(2, 5), 2)
	end
	if not string.match(p9, "^[A-Z0-9]+$") then
		error("AssertTag: must be uppercase letters / digits", 2)
	end
	return p9
end
function v4.AssertDescription(p10) -- name: AssertDescription
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	if typeof(p10) ~= "string" then
		error("AssertDescription: expected string", 2)
	end
	local v11 = utf8.len(p10)
	if not v11 then
		error("AssertDescription: invalid UTF-8", 2)
	end
	if v11 > 200 then
		error(("AssertDescription: must be <= %* characters"):format(200), 2)
	end
	if not v_u_2.IsASCII(p10) then
		error("AssertDescription: must be ASCII", 2)
	end
	return p10
end
function v4.AssertGuildRole(p12) -- name: AssertGuildRole
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	if typeof(p12) ~= "string" or not v_u_5[p12] then
		error("AssertGuildRole: must be \'Owner\' | \'Elder\' | \'Member\'", 2)
	end
	return p12
end
function v4.AssertSlotCount(p13) -- name: AssertSlotCount
	if typeof(p13) ~= "number" or p13 ~= math.floor(p13) then
		error("AssertSlotCount: must be an integer", 2)
	end
	if p13 < 20 or p13 > 50 then
		error(("AssertSlotCount: must be in [%*, %*]"):format(20, 50), 2)
	end
	return p13
end
function v4.AssertUserId(p14) -- name: AssertUserId
	if typeof(p14) ~= "number" or (p14 ~= math.floor(p14) or p14 <= 0) then
		error("AssertUserId: must be a positive integer", 2)
	end
	return p14
end
function v4.AssertHexColor(p15) -- name: AssertHexColor
	if typeof(p15) ~= "string" then

local function v_u_105(p87) -- name: ComputeFootOffset
	local v88 = p87:GetPivot().Position.Y
	local v89 = (1 / 0)
	for _, v90 in p87:GetDescendants() do
		if v90:IsA("BasePart") and v90.Transparency < 1 then
			local v91 = v90.CFrame
			local v92 = v90.Size

			local v94 = v92.Y * 0.5
			local v95 = v92.Z * 0.5
			for v96 = -1, 1, 2 do
				for v97 = -1, 1, 2 do
					local v98 = v96 * v93
					local v99 = v97 * v94
					local v100 = -1 * v95
					local v101 = (v91 * Vector3.new(v98, v99, v100)).Y
					if v101 >= v89 then
						v101 = v89
					end

					local v103 = v97 * v94

					v89 = (v91 * Vector3.new(v102, v103, v104)).Y

						v89 = v101
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

end

	if v40 then

local function v_u_50(p45) -- name: GetSpeedMultiplier
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_12
	if not p45 then

	end

	end

	end

end

		local v10 = buffer.readu8(p2, v6)
		local v11 = v8[bit32.bxor(v9, v10) + 1]
		v5 = bit32.bxor(v7, v11)
	end
	return bit32.bxor(v5, 4294967295)
end

	["Build2"] = function(p110) -- name: Build2
		p110.PlaceInStages["2"]:PivotTo(p110.PlaceInStages["2"]:GetPivot() * CFrame.new(0, 100, 0))
	end,
	["Build3"] = function(p111) -- name: Build3
		p111.PlaceInStages["3"]:PivotTo(p111.PlaceInStages["3"]:GetPivot() * CFrame.new(0, 100, 0))
	end,
	["BuildToNight"] = function(p_u_112) -- name: BuildToNight
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6
		p_u_112.PlaceInStages["4"]:PivotTo(p_u_112.PlaceInStages["4"]:GetPivot() * CFrame.new(0, 100, 0))
		local v_u_113 = p_u_112.QuickPlace:GetChildren()
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_113, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_112
			for v114, v115 in v_u_113 do
				v115:PivotTo(v115:GetPivot() * CFrame.new(0, 100, 0))
				local v116 = v114 / #v_u_113
				local v117 = (v114 + 1) / #v_u_113
				local v118 = (1 - (1 - v116) ^ 2) * 4
				local v119 = (1 - (1 - v117) ^ 2) * 4 - v118
				v_u_6.WorldPosition = v115:GetPivot().p
				for _, v120 in v_u_6:GetChildren() do
					v120:Emit(v120:GetAttribute("EmitCount") or 1)
				end
				task.wait(v119)
			end
			task.delay(4, function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_112
				p_u_112.Fruits["5"].Destroy1:Destroy()
				p_u_112.Fruits["6"].Destroy2:Destroy()
				p_u_112.PlaceInStages["3"].DestroyMe:Destroy()
				p_u_112.PlaceInStages["3"].DestroyMe2:Destroy()
			end)
		end)
		game.Lighting.GeographicLatitude = 24
		local v121 = 0
		while v121 < 4 do
			v121 = v121 + game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait()
			game.Lighting.ClockTime = lerp(14, 6, v121 / 4)
		end
	end,
	["Sweat"] = function(p122) -- name: Sweat
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
		p122.Rigs.Thief.Head.Sweat.Enabled = true
		v_u_3.EnableShaking(p122.Rigs.Thief)
	end,
	["Poof"] = function(p123) -- name: Poof
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2
		v_u_3.DisableShaking(p123.Rigs.Thief)
		p123.VFX.Poof.PixelSmoke:Emit(18)
		v_u_2:Shake(v_u_2.Presets.Bump)
	end,
	["GAG2"] = function(_) -- name: GAG2
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4
		v_u_4.LogoImg.Visible = true
		v_u_4.PressAnyTxt.Visible = true
		task.wait(3)
		game.TweenService:Create(game.Lighting, TweenInfo.new(1), {
			["ClockTime"] = 14
		}):Play()
		task.wait(1)
		game.TweenService:Create(v_u_4.LogoImg.UIScale, TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
			["Scale"] = 1
		}):Play()
		task.delay(4, function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4
			game.TweenService:Create(v_u_4.PressAnyTxt, TweenInfo.new(1), {
				["TextTransparency"] = 0,
				["TextStrokeTransparency"] = 0
			}):Play()
		end)
		task.wait(8)
		game.TweenService:Create(v_u_4.Frame, TweenInfo.new(1), {
			["BackgroundTransparency"] = 0
		}):Play()
	end,
	["EndState"] = function(p124) -- name: EndState
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_15, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_5
		v_u_4.LogoImg.Visible = false
		v_u_4.PressAnyTxt.Visible = false
		workspace:SetAttribute("TimeFrozen", nil)
		game.TweenService:Create(v_u_4.Frame, TweenInfo.new(1), {
			["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1
		}):Play()
		game.Debris:AddItem(v_u_4, 1)
		v_u_16 = nil
		v_u_17 = nil
		v_u_15 = nil
		for _, v125 in v_u_11 do
			v125:Destroy()
		end
		v_u_11 = {}
		v_u_5 = false
		p124.Screen:Destroy()
	end
}

		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6

			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_110, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_109

function configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19) -- name: configureAnimationSet
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	if v_u_14[p_u_18] ~= nil then
		for _, v20 in pairs(v_u_14[p_u_18].connections) do
			v20:disconnect()
		end
	end
	v_u_14[p_u_18] = {}
	v_u_14[p_u_18].count = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_18].connections = {}
	local v21 = script:FindFirstChild(p_u_18)
	if v21 ~= nil then
		local v22 = v_u_14[p_u_18].connections
		local v23 = v21.ChildAdded
		table.insert(v22, v23:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) p_u_19
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19)
		end))
		local v24 = v_u_14[p_u_18].connections
		local v25 = v21.ChildRemoved
		table.insert(v24, v25:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) p_u_19
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19)
		end))
		local v26 = 1
		for _, v27 in pairs(v21:GetChildren()) do
			if v27:IsA("Animation") then
				local v28 = v_u_14[p_u_18].connections
				local v29 = v27.Changed
				table.insert(v28, v29:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) p_u_19
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19)
				end))
				v_u_14[p_u_18][v26] = {}
				v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].anim = v27
				local v30 = v27:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				if v30 == nil then
					v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].weight = 1
				else
					v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].weight = v30.Value
				end
				v_u_14[p_u_18].count = v_u_14[p_u_18].count + 1
				v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight + v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].weight
				v26 = v26 + 1
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_18].count <= 0 then
		for v31, v32 in pairs(p_u_19) do
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31] = {}
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].anim.Name = p_u_18
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].anim.AnimationId = v32.id
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].weight = v32.weight
			v_u_14[p_u_18].count = v_u_14[p_u_18].count + 1
			v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight + v32.weight
		end
	end
end

function playAnimation(p50, p51, p52) -- name: playAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_13, (ref) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_12
	local v53 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p50].totalWeight)
	local v54 = 1
	while v_u_14[p50][v54].weight < v53 do
		v53 = v53 - v_u_14[p50][v54].weight
		v54 = v54 + 1
	end
	local v55 = v_u_14[p50][v54].anim
	if v55 ~= v_u_10 then
		if v_u_11 ~= nil then
			v_u_11:Stop(p51)
			v_u_11:Destroy()
		end
		v_u_13 = 1
		v_u_11 = p52:LoadAnimation(v55)
		v_u_11.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
		v_u_11:Play(p51)
		v_u_9 = p50
		v_u_10 = v55
		if v_u_12 ~= nil then
			v_u_12:disconnect()
		end
		v_u_12 = v_u_11.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
	end
end

function animateTool() -- name: animateTool
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_40, (copy) v_u_7
	if v_u_40 == "None" then
		playToolAnimation("toolnone", 0.1, v_u_7, Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle)
		return
	elseif v_u_40 == "Slash" then
		playToolAnimation("toolslash", 0, v_u_7, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
		return
	elseif v_u_40 == "Lunge" then
		playToolAnimation("toollunge", 0, v_u_7, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
	end
end
function moveSit() -- name: moveSit
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_6
	v_u_3.MaxVelocity = 0.15
	v_u_4.MaxVelocity = 0.15
	v_u_3:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
	v_u_4:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
	v_u_5:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
	v_u_6:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
end
local v_u_77 = 0
function move(p78) -- name: move
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (ref) v_u_42, (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_40, (ref) v_u_41, (ref) v_u_58
	local v79 = 1
	local v80 = 1
	local v81 = p78 - v_u_77
	v_u_77 = p78
	local v82 = false
	if v_u_42 > 0 then
		v_u_42 = v_u_42 - v81
	end
	if v_u_8 == "FreeFall" and v_u_42 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.3, v_u_7)
	else
		if v_u_8 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_7)
			return
		end
		if v_u_8 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.1, v_u_7)
		elseif v_u_8 == "Dead" or (v_u_8 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_8 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_8 == "Seated" or v_u_8 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
			v82 = true
			v80 = 1
			v79 = 0.1
		end
	end
	if v82 then
		local v83 = p78 * v80
		local v84 = v79 * math.sin(v83)
		v_u_3:SetDesiredAngle(v84 + 0)
		v_u_4:SetDesiredAngle(v84 - 0)
		v_u_5:SetDesiredAngle(-v84)
		v_u_6:SetDesiredAngle(-v84)
	end
	local v85 = getTool()
	if v85 and v85:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v86 = getToolAnim(v85)
		if v86 then
			v_u_40 = v86.Value
			v86.Parent = nil
			v_u_41 = p78 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_41 < p78 then
			v_u_41 = 0
			v_u_40 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_40 = "None"
		v_u_58 = nil
		v_u_41 = 0
	end
end

function configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19) -- name: configureAnimationSet
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	if v_u_14[p_u_18] ~= nil then
		for _, v20 in pairs(v_u_14[p_u_18].connections) do
			v20:disconnect()
		end
	end
	v_u_14[p_u_18] = {}
	v_u_14[p_u_18].count = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_18].connections = {}
	local v21 = script:FindFirstChild(p_u_18)
	if v21 ~= nil then
		local v22 = v_u_14[p_u_18].connections
		local v23 = v21.ChildAdded
		table.insert(v22, v23:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) p_u_19
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19)
		end))
		local v24 = v_u_14[p_u_18].connections
		local v25 = v21.ChildRemoved
		table.insert(v24, v25:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) p_u_19
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19)
		end))
		local v26 = 1
		for _, v27 in pairs(v21:GetChildren()) do
			if v27:IsA("Animation") then
				local v28 = v_u_14[p_u_18].connections
				local v29 = v27.Changed
				table.insert(v28, v29:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) p_u_19
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19)
				end))
				v_u_14[p_u_18][v26] = {}
				v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].anim = v27
				local v30 = v27:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				if v30 == nil then
					v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].weight = 1
				else
					v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].weight = v30.Value
				end
				v_u_14[p_u_18].count = v_u_14[p_u_18].count + 1
				v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight + v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].weight
				v26 = v26 + 1
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_18].count <= 0 then
		for v31, v32 in pairs(p_u_19) do
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31] = {}
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].anim.Name = p_u_18
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].anim.AnimationId = v32.id
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].weight = v32.weight
			v_u_14[p_u_18].count = v_u_14[p_u_18].count + 1
			v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight + v32.weight
		end
	end
end

function move(p78) -- name: move
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (ref) v_u_42, (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_40, (ref) v_u_41, (ref) v_u_58

	end

function configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19) -- name: configureAnimationSet
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	if v_u_14[p_u_18] ~= nil then
		for _, v20 in pairs(v_u_14[p_u_18].connections) do
			v20:disconnect()
		end
	end
	v_u_14[p_u_18] = {}
	v_u_14[p_u_18].count = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_18].connections = {}
	local v21 = script:FindFirstChild(p_u_18)
	if v21 ~= nil then
		local v22 = v_u_14[p_u_18].connections
		local v23 = v21.ChildAdded
		table.insert(v22, v23:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) p_u_19
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19)
		end))
		local v24 = v_u_14[p_u_18].connections
		local v25 = v21.ChildRemoved
		table.insert(v24, v25:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) p_u_19
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19)
		end))
		local v26 = 1
		for _, v27 in pairs(v21:GetChildren()) do
			if v27:IsA("Animation") then
				local v28 = v_u_14[p_u_18].connections
				local v29 = v27.Changed
				table.insert(v28, v29:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) p_u_19
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19)
				end))
				v_u_14[p_u_18][v26] = {}
				v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].anim = v27
				local v30 = v27:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				if v30 == nil then
					v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].weight = 1
				else
					v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].weight = v30.Value
				end
				v_u_14[p_u_18].count = v_u_14[p_u_18].count + 1
				v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight + v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].weight
				v26 = v26 + 1
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_18].count <= 0 then
		for v31, v32 in pairs(p_u_19) do
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31] = {}
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].anim.Name = p_u_18
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].anim.AnimationId = v32.id
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].weight = v32.weight
			v_u_14[p_u_18].count = v_u_14[p_u_18].count + 1
			v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight + v32.weight
		end
	end
end

function playAnimation(p50, p51, p52) -- name: playAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_13, (ref) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_12
	local v53 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p50].totalWeight)
	local v54 = 1
	while v_u_14[p50][v54].weight < v53 do
		v53 = v53 - v_u_14[p50][v54].weight
		v54 = v54 + 1
	end
	local v55 = v_u_14[p50][v54].anim
	if v55 ~= v_u_10 then
		if v_u_11 ~= nil then
			v_u_11:Stop(p51)
			v_u_11:Destroy()
		end
		v_u_13 = 1
		v_u_11 = p52:LoadAnimation(v55)
		v_u_11.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
		v_u_11:Play(p51)
		v_u_9 = p50
		v_u_10 = v55
		if v_u_12 ~= nil then
			v_u_12:disconnect()
		end
		v_u_12 = v_u_11.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
	end
end

function animateTool() -- name: animateTool
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_40, (copy) v_u_7
	if v_u_40 == "None" then
		playToolAnimation("toolnone", 0.1, v_u_7, Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle)

		return
	elseif v_u_40 == "Lunge" then
		playToolAnimation("toollunge", 0, v_u_7, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
	end
end

function move(p78) -- name: move
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (ref) v_u_42, (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_40, (ref) v_u_41, (ref) v_u_58
	local v79 = 1
	local v80 = 1
	local v81 = p78 - v_u_77
	v_u_77 = p78
	local v82 = false
	if v_u_42 > 0 then
		v_u_42 = v_u_42 - v81
	end
	if v_u_8 == "FreeFall" and v_u_42 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.3, v_u_7)
	else
		if v_u_8 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_7)
			return
		end
		if v_u_8 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.1, v_u_7)
		elseif v_u_8 == "Dead" or (v_u_8 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_8 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_8 == "Seated" or v_u_8 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
			v82 = true
			v80 = 1
			v79 = 0.1
		end
	end
	if v82 then
		local v83 = p78 * v80
		local v84 = v79 * math.sin(v83)
		v_u_3:SetDesiredAngle(v84 + 0)
		v_u_4:SetDesiredAngle(v84 - 0)
		v_u_5:SetDesiredAngle(-v84)
		v_u_6:SetDesiredAngle(-v84)
	end
	local v85 = getTool()
	if v85 and v85:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v86 = getToolAnim(v85)
		if v86 then
			v_u_40 = v86.Value
			v86.Parent = nil
			v_u_41 = p78 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_41 < p78 then
			v_u_41 = 0
			v_u_40 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_40 = "None"
		v_u_58 = nil
		v_u_41 = 0
	end
end

function configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19) -- name: configureAnimationSet
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	if v_u_14[p_u_18] ~= nil then
		for _, v20 in pairs(v_u_14[p_u_18].connections) do
			v20:disconnect()
		end
	end
	v_u_14[p_u_18] = {}
	v_u_14[p_u_18].count = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_18].connections = {}
	local v21 = script:FindFirstChild(p_u_18)
	if v21 ~= nil then
		local v22 = v_u_14[p_u_18].connections
		local v23 = v21.ChildAdded
		table.insert(v22, v23:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) p_u_19
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19)
		end))
		local v24 = v_u_14[p_u_18].connections
		local v25 = v21.ChildRemoved
		table.insert(v24, v25:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) p_u_19
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19)
		end))
		local v26 = 1
		for _, v27 in pairs(v21:GetChildren()) do
			if v27:IsA("Animation") then
				local v28 = v_u_14[p_u_18].connections
				local v29 = v27.Changed
				table.insert(v28, v29:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) p_u_19
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_18, p_u_19)
				end))
				v_u_14[p_u_18][v26] = {}
				v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].anim = v27
				local v30 = v27:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				if v30 == nil then
					v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].weight = 1
				else
					v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].weight = v30.Value
				end
				v_u_14[p_u_18].count = v_u_14[p_u_18].count + 1
				v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight + v_u_14[p_u_18][v26].weight
				v26 = v26 + 1
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_18].count <= 0 then
		for v31, v32 in pairs(p_u_19) do
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31] = {}
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].anim.Name = p_u_18
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].anim.AnimationId = v32.id
			v_u_14[p_u_18][v31].weight = v32.weight
			v_u_14[p_u_18].count = v_u_14[p_u_18].count + 1
			v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_18].totalWeight + v32.weight
		end
	end
end

function playAnimation(p50, p51, p52) -- name: playAnimation

	local v53 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p50].totalWeight)
	local v54 = 1
	while v_u_14[p50][v54].weight < v53 do
		v53 = v53 - v_u_14[p50][v54].weight
		v54 = v54 + 1
	end
	local v55 = v_u_14[p50][v54].anim
	if v55 ~= v_u_10 then
		if v_u_11 ~= nil then
			v_u_11:Stop(p51)
			v_u_11:Destroy()
		end
		v_u_13 = 1
		v_u_11 = p52:LoadAnimation(v55)
		v_u_11.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
		v_u_11:Play(p51)
		v_u_9 = p50
		v_u_10 = v55
		if v_u_12 ~= nil then
			v_u_12:disconnect()
		end
		v_u_12 = v_u_11.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)

end

function move(p78) -- name: move
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (ref) v_u_42, (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_40, (ref) v_u_41, (ref) v_u_58
	local v79 = 1
	local v80 = 1
	local v81 = p78 - v_u_77
	v_u_77 = p78
	local v82 = false
	if v_u_42 > 0 then
		v_u_42 = v_u_42 - v81
	end
	if v_u_8 == "FreeFall" and v_u_42 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.3, v_u_7)
	else
		if v_u_8 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_7)
			return
		end
		if v_u_8 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.1, v_u_7)
		elseif v_u_8 == "Dead" or (v_u_8 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_8 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_8 == "Seated" or v_u_8 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
			v82 = true
			v80 = 1
			v79 = 0.1
		end
	end
	if v82 then
		local v83 = p78 * v80
		local v84 = v79 * math.sin(v83)
		v_u_3:SetDesiredAngle(v84 + 0)
		v_u_4:SetDesiredAngle(v84 - 0)
		v_u_5:SetDesiredAngle(-v84)
		v_u_6:SetDesiredAngle(-v84)
	end
	local v85 = getTool()
	if v85 and v85:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v86 = getToolAnim(v85)
		if v86 then
			v_u_40 = v86.Value
			v86.Parent = nil
			v_u_41 = p78 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_41 < p78 then
			v_u_41 = 0
			v_u_40 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_40 = "None"
		v_u_58 = nil
		v_u_41 = 0
	end
end

function move(p78) -- name: move
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (ref) v_u_42, (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_40, (ref) v_u_41, (ref) v_u_58

	local v80 = 1
	local v81 = p78 - v_u_77
	v_u_77 = p78
	local v82 = false
	if v_u_42 > 0 then
		v_u_42 = v_u_42 - v81
	end
	if v_u_8 == "FreeFall" and v_u_42 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.3, v_u_7)
	else
		if v_u_8 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_7)
			return
		end
		if v_u_8 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.1, v_u_7)
		elseif v_u_8 == "Dead" or (v_u_8 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_8 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_8 == "Seated" or v_u_8 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
			v82 = true
			v80 = 1
			v79 = 0.1
		end
	end
	if v82 then
		local v83 = p78 * v80
		local v84 = v79 * math.sin(v83)
		v_u_3:SetDesiredAngle(v84 + 0)
		v_u_4:SetDesiredAngle(v84 - 0)
		v_u_5:SetDesiredAngle(-v84)
		v_u_6:SetDesiredAngle(-v84)
	end
	local v85 = getTool()
	if v85 and v85:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v86 = getToolAnim(v85)
		if v86 then
			v_u_40 = v86.Value
			v86.Parent = nil
			v_u_41 = p78 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_41 < p78 then
			v_u_41 = 0
			v_u_40 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_40 = "None"
		v_u_58 = nil
		v_u_41 = 0
	end
end

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) p_u_19

		local v25 = v21.ChildRemoved

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) p_u_19

				local v28 = v_u_14[p_u_18].connections

				table.insert(v28, v29:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) p_u_19
